title: Acoustic band gap computation
action: Implement the plane-wave expansion method for the scalar acoustic wave equation (∂²p/∂t² = λ ∇·(∇p/ρ)) on an fcc lattice of spheres. Set sphere volume fraction to 14.4% and host-to-sphere longitudinal velocity ratio c_lo/c_li = 2.65. For each density ratio y ∈ {5, 1, 1/15}, compute the band structure or density of states, identify the lowest complete frequency gap (if any), and record gap presence together with gap lower edge, upper edge, and gap-to-midgap ratio. Write the results to /app/outputs/gap_results.json.
description: Single JSON file containing gap analysis for the three acoustic density-ratio conditions.
output_schema: A JSON object with key 'results' containing an array of 3 objects. Each object has keys: density_ratio (float), gap_present (bool), gap_lower_frequency (float or null), gap_upper_frequency (float or null), gap_midgap_ratio (float or null). If no gap exists, set gap_present=false and the frequency/ratio fields to null. Frequencies are normalized in consistent reduced units (e.g., ω a/(2π c) or similar).
